description: Tropical Smoothie Cafe is a better-for-you fast-casual franchise founded in 1997 in Destin, Florida, selling handcrafted smoothies plus sandwiches, flatbreads, wraps, salads, and bowls. The franchisor, TSC Franchisor, LLC of Atlanta, Georgia, took over the system in September 2024 and is ultimately backed by investment funds affiliated with Blackstone. As of December 28, 2025 the system had 1,651 outlets (1,650 franchised, 1 company-owned) across 42 states and DC. FDD Item 19 reports average 2025 Net Revenue of $978,298 across 1,431 restaurants open at least a full year, with a top-10% average of $1,709,270.
territoryDescription: Non-exclusive. No exclusive territory; you operate at an approved location only. Protected Area = one-half mile radius around your cafe (unavailable at Reserved Facilities). Franchisor reserves rights to own/license cafes at Reserved Facilities inside your Protected Area and to sell/distribute products under the Marks (or other marks) through any channel — grocery, retail, internet — anywhere inside or outside your Protected Area. 1,651 outlets systemwide as of 12/28/2025. (FDD Item 12, pp.42-43; Item 20, p.59)
item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 Table No. 1 (p.59): 1,651 outlets as of 12/28/2025 (1,650 franchised + 1 company-owned). The 11 pins are a FEATURED selection — the franchisor HQ in Atlanta, GA plus one representative market in each of 10 states with confirmed 2025 Item 20 outlet counts (FL 217, TX 153, MI 124, VA 124, MD 70, OH 69, IL 68, NY 62, PA 48, NC 81) — not a census.
risk_score_method: base 20 +8 capital intensity (ceiling $770,500) +8 ongoing fee burden 11% (6% royalty + 5% marketing) +2 litigation (2 disclosed matters, both settled, none pending) +6 non-exclusive territory with Protected Area and reserved-facility/alternative-channel rights +1 renewal/modernization cost drag +2 semi-absentee model (manager-dependent, Operating Principal >=5%) +1 franchised-concentration (99.9% of 1,651 outlets franchised) -8 Item 19 strength (1,431 outlets, avg $978,298, ~87% coverage) -4 unit growth +37.8% (2023-2025) -2 audited financials (Exhibit J) -2 PE backing (Blackstone) -1 no bankruptcy disclosed = 31/100
